200.description: The specified devices' properties were returned successfully.

get.description:
Retrieve the list of identifying information for discovered devices. 

The number and set of devices returned can be filtered by using the query parameters. It is suggested to limit the use of the query parameters to the following combinations:
- `first`
- `first` & `after`
- `last`
- `last` & `before`

If more than 1,000 devices are discovered, clients must send successive requests to obtain all devices.

PageInfo.title: PageInfo
PageInfo.description: `PageInfo` informs the client if there is additional pages of data before or after the data in this response that can be queried. `startCursor` and `endCursor` are used to prepare the next page to request. When `startCursor` and `endCursor` are non-empty strings, they reflect the edges/data at the first and last position in the response being processed.

hasNextPage.description: Whether there is data on the server following this page of data.

hasPreviousPage.description: Whether there is data on the server prior to this page of data.

startCursor.description: If specified, only nodes with a cursor value lexically greater than `startCursor` are returned. This set of nodes is then subject to page limits set by the `first`, `last`, and `endCursor` parameters.

endCursor.description: If specified, only nodes with a cursor value lexically less than `startCursor` are returned. This set of nodes is then subject to page limits set by the `first`, `last`, and `startCursor` parameters.

AudioChannelGroupV2.title: AudioChannelGroupV2
AudioChannelGroupV2.description:
Discriminator for audio channel purpose and functionality. 

The values returned from this field will expand over time. Any code using this should remain open to extension to new values to prevent breaking changes on upgrades. If a value were to ever be removed in the future, that change would be considered breaking and a new API would be introduced to communicate the new possible values. 

 These are the currently supported values for this release:
- `ADC_INPUT` (New in System API Server 6.7)
- `AEC_REFERENCE`
- `AEC_REFERENCE_MIX_OUTPUT` (New in System API Server 6.7)
- `AES3_INPUT` (New in System API Server TBD)
- `ANALOG_70V_OUTPUT`
- `ANALOG_AUX_INPUT`
- `ANALOG_INPUT` (Added in System API Server 6.4)
- `ANALOG_OUTPUT`
- `AURACAST_OUTPUT` (New in System API Server TBD)
- `AUTOMIX`
- `AUTOMIX_STEREO` (Added in System API Server 6.6)
- `AUX_INPUT`
- `AUX_OUTPUT`
- `BACK`
- `BLUETOOTH_INPUT`
- `BLUETOOTH_OUTPUT`
- `DANTE_ANALOG_INPUT`
- `DANTE_AUX_INPUT`

- `DANTE_LINE_INPUT`
- `DANTE_LINE_OUTPUT`
- `DANTE_MIC_INPUT`

- `DIRECT_OUTPUT`
- `DIRECT_OUTPUT_ANALOG_INPUT` (Added in System API Server 6.4)
- `DIRECT_OUTPUT_DANTE_MIC_INPUT` (Added in System API Server 6.6)
- `EXTERNAL_AUTOMIX` (New in System API Server 6.7) 
- `GENERIC`
- `HEADPHONE`
- `LOBE`
- `LOUDSPEAKER`
- `MIC`
- `MIX_OUTPUT`
- `MOBILE_INPUT`
- `MOBILE_OUTPUT`

TooManyRequestsResponse.description:
The request was rejected because a rate limit or quota was exceeded.

When the `Retry-After` response header is present, its value is the number of seconds the client should wait before retrying. When the header is absent, a longer-period allowance has been exhausted and retrying will continue to fail until it resets.

Where and how these limits apply depends on the deployment; consult the deployment-specific documentation for details.

Retry-After.description: Number of seconds the client should wait before retrying. Present for short-term rate limiting; absent when a longer-period allowance has been exhausted.

first.name: first
first.description:
Limit the number of records to return starting from the beginning of the data. 

 The actual number of records returned may be less depending on 

 - Other query parameters 
 - The remaining data on the server 
 - The integrity of the data on the server (e.g is all required data for the record able to be returned). The default value for this limit is 1000.

last.name: last
last.description:
Limit the number of records to return starting from the end of the data.  

 The actual number of records returned may be less depending on 

 - Other query parameters 
 - The remaining data on the server 
 - The integrity of the data on the server (e.g is all required data for the record able to be returned)

before.name: before
before.description: A url-encoded cursor value used by the server to filter the results. Only records with a cursor lexically less than the value of `before` will be returned.

after.name: after
after.description: A url-encoded cursor value used by the server to filter the results. Only records with a cursor lexically greater than the value of `after` will be returned.
